description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings, specifically for converting strings to camelCase and Title Case, used across the application's UI components.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and multiple whitespace, preserving original value if input is not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case, handling delimiters, apostrophes, accented characters, and whitespace normalization, preserving original value if input is not a string.
